name: Porno Sakka Mayuka to, Injuku Miboujin to Katabutsu Henshuusha to Ubu Gishi
original_name: ポルノ作家麻由華と、淫熟未亡人と堅物編集者とウブ義姉
source: Moving into a new apartment with his step sister, the protagonist is starting his new job as editor. His first assignment is to be assistant to famous author in helping with her new book. To his surprise the author is a romance/erotic writer that he is a fan of. Only to be disappointed to find out her true character is bossy and rude. One day he is given orders to go to her apartment at night time which he is then sexual assaulted without fully comprehending it. She tells him he is a great model to use for her next book being a weak will man and wants to keep using him to help with her new book.
translation: 主角和继妹搬进了新公寓，开始了编辑的新工作。他的第一个任务是担任著名作家的助手，帮助她写新书。令他惊讶的是，作者是一位他喜欢的浪漫/色情作家。只是失望地发现她的真实性格是专横和粗鲁。有一天，他被命令在晚上去她的公寓，然后他在没有完全理解的情况下遭到了性侵犯。她告诉他，他是一个意志薄弱的人，她是一个很好的榜样，可以在她的下一本书中使用，并希望继续使用他来帮助她的新书。
